Pop-up Shops in Amsterdam this week

All this week's events

23 – 29 Nov · 5 events

Temporary shops, multi-brand pop-up stores and short-lived concept spaces selling a mix of goods. Good for discovering small labels and independent makers before they find a permanent home, or for picking up a gift with a story. We update the list every week as shops open and close. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

Showing today onwards
